reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system is a retroreflective optical integrated sensing and communication (RO-ISAC) system, which uses a flexible waveform design based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing-embedded maximum length sequence (OFDM-MLS) to achieve both communication and sensing. The OFDM-MLS waveform is designed to embed OFDM samples into a MLS sequence, allowing for flexible performance trade-off between communication and sensing by adaptively adjusting the power allocation ratio between the MLS signal and the OFDM signal.
